mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the arm to the breathing supply circuit was most worthwhile: the resulting inset shows oxygen and nutrients reaching cells, carbon dioxide returning, and excess fluid entering lymph vessels.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding collecting vessels felt less distinctive because the result mainly extended the pathway without explaining much about their role.

surprise.text: I was interested to learn that body movement and breathing help move lymph, while valves limit backward flow.

arbitrary.text: No combination felt purposeless: each added a plausible part of the drainage or supply route. The choices were all prescribed, though, so I did not discover their compatibility myself.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it brought systems together as clearly as the final tissue inset, though the sequence of single available combinations offered little opportunity for meaningful decisions.
